name: ST-149
description: ST-149, or ST 149 was a Delta-class T-3c shuttle that was used as a transport for Director Orson Krennic and his death trooper unit. Krennic chose the ship due to his appreciation for its unusual geometry, although he held no sentimentality for the craft. Captain Dunstig Pterro held more affection for the ship, nicknaming it Pteradon.

data.name: ST-149
data.engine: SFS-215 ion engines (optimised for stealth operations)
data.hull: Sloped hull (skin composite optimised for stealth operations)
armament: Twin Taim & Bak KX9 laser cannons (2)
